title: Anthropic shares slump on second day of trading as markets reel from AI sell-off
summary_full: Asian markets record worst week since 2020 as investors question huge sums being poured into AI build-outWho are Anthropic’s seven co-founders, now worth $180bn?Anthropic’s shares fell at the start of its second day of trading, as its record-breaking IPO failed to stem a sell-off in AI-linked companies.Shares in the frontier AI company behind the Claude chatbot, which floated in the US on Thursday, fell by as much as 12% on Friday. They dropped to $85.12, towards the $83 level at which Anthropic priced its stock market debut. Continue reading...
